label: H.Res. 863
title: Honoring the heroic military service, sacrifices, and contributions of veterans from the great State of Texas, and for other purposes.

items.snippet: This resolution honors the service, sacrifice, and contributions of Texas veterans and their families.
This resolution honors the service, sacrifice, and contributions of Texas veterans and their families.

The resolution also expresses that the House of Representatives commits to working with the Department of Veterans Affairs to ensure that veterans are provided timely care and applicable benefits and compensation as a result of their service.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

C001130.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
C001130.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
C001130.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
